tasks.title: Budget outline snapshot, stable leaf key, and the statement's governed projection
tasks.objective: Give the statement something to be built on: persist the budget workbook's outline as a per-batch snapshot keyed by a stable leaf key (decision 0021), record the provisional budget-leaf to SAP (cost centre, GL) correspondence in the versioned Mapping Master, and add the statement's own governed projection at leaf/month grain (decision 0022) while leaving the shipped (gl_code, month) relation untouched. No HTTP route, no UI - those are tasks 2, 3 and 4.
acceptance_criteria: The budget parser walks the workbook outline and records it as a per-batch snapshot - the ordered section, component and leaf tree with each node's S. No., label and ordering, parent_key referencing a node in the SAME batch - carrying NO monetary amount; every leaf gains a stable key derived from its identity rather than its sheet row number, mis_budget carries that same leaf_key so amounts and structure join without touching GL, and the snapshot is persisted inside the same transaction that writes the rows and activates the batch.

The Mapping Master records a TAGGED target for every entry - either a workbook leaf key or the reserved unmapped-GL bucket of decision 0018 - as provisional entries with reasons, so a SAP (cost centre, GL) triple resolves to exactly one target, recorded rather than inferred; the loader rejects two entries claiming one triple for different targets; and budget ingest validates the candidate snapshot's leaf keys against the master's declared targets so a renamed or renumbered line is reported as drift rather than silently splitting one statement line in two.

The statement's governed projection returns Budget and Actual full-outer-joined at leaf/month grain, filtering Actuals by the master's resolved triples BEFORE aggregating per decision 0017 and reaching the builder through a typed leafTargets entry on GovernedSelectionScope rather than a global master import, with no fan-out and leaf-grain totals exact against the pinned July batch; the shipped (gl_code, month) relation and all six existing gated warehouse proofs are unchanged. Parent-by-parent footing belongs to task 2, which owns tree derivation.

required_tests.id: the budget parser records the workbook outline as an ordered snapshot carrying no amounts and gives each leaf a stable key that survives a reordered workbook
the mapping master resolves a SAP cost centre and GL triple to exactly one statement leaf and records the budget leaf correspondence as provisional with a reason
the statement projection full outer joins budget and actual at leaf and month grain filtering actuals by the resolved triples before aggregating and leaves the gl code and month relation untouched
budget ingest reports mapping drift when the candidate outline no longer carries a leaf key the master declares instead of silently splitting the line

reviewer_focus: DOUBLE COUNTING is the defect class this task exists to avoid. The snapshot table has NO amount column - that is structural, not a convention. Decision 0020 stands: leaf rows only, no stored parent amounts.

FAN-OUT at the new grain. A leaf/month join can fan out where the GL/month one did not. The gated proof must assert EXACT row counts and EXACT July leaf totals, not merely that a query returns rows, and must run with its dead-port negative control.

The stable leaf key must NOT be the sheet row number, and the budget/snapshot join must NOT fall back to GL - joining on GL re-merges exactly the 50001605 / 50001606 / 50001901 lines this story exists to split.

The unmapped-GL bucket has no workbook leaf: the master's target is TAGGED (leaf or bucket). Do not force the nine bucket triples to invent a leaf key. A bucket row carries zero Budget, its own Actual, and still counts toward the grand total (decision 0018).

The triple-to-leaf mapping must reach the builder through a typed GovernedSelectionScope field. Importing MAPPING_MASTER inside sqlBuilder bypasses the injectable-master seam selection-resolution was fixed to establish.
Decision 0022's promise is kept by EVIDENCE: the shipped (gl_code, month) relation is untouched and all six existing gated warehouse proofs pass unchanged.

The migration, its journal metadata and warehouse-schema.test.ts's pinned last-migration number move TOGETHER; the snapshot is written inside the same transaction that activates the batch, or a rolled-back batch leaves an orphan.

Standards: constitution/03-modular-monolith-structure.md and pnp-coding-standards-modular-monolith.md for module layout and the .interface.ts naming rule; the database/migration standards for the new table, column and view; decision 0015 keeps the warehouse snake_case.

review_budget.reason: The story's foundation, and the task grill showed the original 13-file budget could not even reach the code it needed. Four inseparable deliverables: the outline snapshot (new table, new column, migration plus its journal and the pinned-migration test, and a parser that must now genuinely WALK the outline rather than test each row's formula independently); the persistence route through IngestService and replaceBudgetBatch inside the batch's own transaction; the master's tagged leaf-or-bucket targets with their loader rejection and the ingest-time drift check; and a second governed shape at leaf/month grain reaching the builder through a typed scope field, with its own gated D-0008 exact-reconciliation and no-fan-out proof plus registration. The projection is meaningless without the leaf key it groups by, and the leaf key is meaningless without the snapshot that defines it.

tasks.title: The governed statement route
tasks.objective: Expose the hierarchical statement over HTTP: POST api/mis/statement returning the statement tree, its measures for the selected month and FY 26-27 YTD, the resolved scope readout and provenance - behind the same guard and governed report grant the shipped selection routes use, following decision 0019's vendored house style.
acceptance_criteria: POST api/mis/statement accepts the four selectors already validated by misSelectionRunRequestSchema and returns the statement as a TREE built from the active budget batch's outline snapshot: every parent is a subtotal DERIVED from its leaves bottom-up and never read from storage, the grand total foots against the leaves, rows come back in the outline's sort_order, and each row carries its S. No., Budget Component label and - for leaves - the GL code.

Each row carries Budget, Roll-over, Actual and % for BOTH period blocks - the selected month and FY 26-27 YTD - with Roll-over present but unpopulated per the spec, amounts computed in exact paise and rounded only at the presentation boundary so subtotals foot, and the percentage keeping the governed measure's labels verbatim rather than being coerced to a number.

The route preserves the outcome split mis-selection settled - an unauthorized plant is refused, while a plant the master does not cover returns the unresolvable outcome with its notice rather than a 403, and a resolved selection with no transactions returns a configured zero statement WITHOUT the notice - and the unmapped-GL line is present with its own Actual and zero Budget, counted in the grand total per decision 0018.

required_tests.id: the statement route returns the outline as a tree whose parent rows are subtotals derived from their leaves with the grand total footing and rows in outline order
each statement row carries budget rollover actual and percentage for both the selected month and the financial year to date with rollover unpopulated and the percentage label kept verbatim

the statement route refuses an unauthorized plant but returns the unresolvable outcome with its notice for a plant the master does not cover and a configured zero statement without the notice when there are no transactions
the unmapped GL line is present with its own actual and zero budget and is counted in the grand total

reviewer_focus: PARENTS ARE DERIVED, never read. Decision 0020 stores no parent amounts and the outline snapshot carries no money at all, so a parent subtotal that comes from anywhere but its own leaves is a defect. The footing proof is THIS task's - statement-model deliberately proved only the leaf grain it produced.

EXACT PAISE through the service; round only at the presentation boundary. Rounding per line is what makes subtotals stop footing, and a statement whose parents do not foot is worthless to the person checking it.

The percentage measure returns LABELS ('over-budget', 'credit / negative actual') when budget is zero. Pass a non-numeric measure value through verbatim - mis-selection shipped NaN to a live page for exactly this.
Coverage is NOT authorization: a plant the master does not cover is UNRESOLVABLE, never 403. mis-selection shipped that defect once and had to split the branches mid-review.
Two period blocks, not one: the selected month AND FY 26-27 YTD, per the spec. Roll-over renders but stays empty until Srihari's rule (decision 0016 defers it).

Constitution: an explicit service interface lives in its own .interface.ts file (constitution/pnp-coding-standards-modular-monolith.md); decision 0019 governs the route's house style - unversioned path, raw typed body, direct module import, DTOs beside mis-selection.dto.ts.

The outline read is a NEW repository surface. It must respect the same active-batch rule the projection uses (source_kind = 'budget' AND is_active), or the tree and the numbers will describe different batches.

review_budget.reason: The route plus the tree assembly it exists to serve, and a new repository read: nothing persists the outline TREE for reporting today - statement-model wrote it and only the insert path exists - so the service needs a reader that honours the same active-batch rule as the projection. The tree derivation, its two period blocks and the unresolvable/403 split are the substance; no schema change, no SQL change, no UI.

tasks.title: The Financial MIS statement on screen
tasks.objective: Render the statement a person can read and hand to Srihari: the workbook's hierarchy at its natural depth, derived subtotals, the grand total, both zero states kept distinct, and the visible unmapped-GL line - reached from MIS Reports and matching the imported design prototype's metrics.
acceptance_criteria: The statement renders the budget outline at its natural uneven depth - two levels for most sections, three under Admin Expenses - with each row showing its S. No., Budget Component and leaf GL, parents visibly subtotalling their children, the grand total footing, and the Roll-over column present but unpopulated.

Measures render for the selected month and FY 26-27 YTD in Indian grouping with the rupee symbol, and a non-numeric measure value such as over-budget or credit / negative actual is passed through VERBATIM rather than numeric-formatted into NaN.
The two zero states are rendered distinctly, branched on the response outcome rather than row emptiness, and the unmapped-GL line is visible with its own Actual.

tasks.title: Excel export of the statement
tasks.objective: Let Srihari take the statement away: POST api/mis/statement/export streams an exceljs workbook built from the SAME payload the screen renders, with the hierarchy and values intact - the first download route in the app - plus the download affordance on the statement view.
acceptance_criteria: POST api/mis/statement/export returns an xlsx workbook as a streamed download with a Content-Disposition filename, behind the same guard and governed report grant as the statement route, built from the same statement payload the screen renders rather than a second assembly of the numbers.

The exported sheet carries the same hierarchy, the same identity columns and the same values as the screen - including the unmapped-GL line and the unpopulated Roll-over column - with parents as derived subtotals and the grand total footing after the declared rounding.
The statement view offers the download and surfaces a failure legibly rather than silently doing nothing.
